artifact_semantics.BASELINE_RESULTS.json: B0/B1/B2 only; consequence_authority=false and no authoritative prediction.
artifact_semantics.CIR_CANDIDATE.json: Carrier-neutral candidate graph. Static/name/flow discovery cannot self-establish consequence semantics.
artifact_semantics.E0_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION.json: Optional run-specific timing/host observation; excluded from semantic seal and prediction scoring.
artifact_semantics.E0_OUTPUT_SEAL.json: Hash closure over every semantic artifact and the exact machine input packet identity.
artifact_semantics.E0_PREDICTION.json: Exactly one noncanonical E0 prediction, authority=false, with hard-stop/witness reference where applicable.
artifact_semantics.E0_RUN_MANIFEST.json: Input identities, engine/freeze identities, semantic artifact hashes, semantic seal digest, no clock-derived fields.
artifact_semantics.PROBE_PLAN.json: Deterministic minimum-evidence target-only probe requests derived from unresolved obligations; no source-science or metric rewrite.
artifact_semantics.REFINEMENT_MAP_CANDIDATE.json: Explicit candidate relation mapping with ESTABLISHED forbidden unless independently evidence-backed under frozen rules; unresolved relations remain explicit.
artifact_semantics.REFINEMENT_REQUESTS.json: Same frozen target-only CEGAR restrictions in machine-readable form.
artifact_semantics.VBE_OBLIGATIONS.json: All frozen VBE material obligations with boolean satisfaction plus unresolved list.

allowed_pre_freeze_target_information: unit identity and order from corpus/0.1/ENROLLMENT.json
contamination_boundary.rule: No implementation or qualification choice may use held-out target-specific semantic information before the final machine-first engine freeze is merged and main-qualified.

determinism_and_seal.seal_digest: SHA-256 over canonical JSON map of semantic artifact path -> SHA-256 plus exact input packet digest and frozen engine identity.
determinism_and_seal.semantic_artifact_hash: SHA-256 over exact canonical artifact bytes.
determinism_and_seal.semantic_replay_requirement: Same engine bytes + same input packet bytes must produce byte-identical semantic artifacts and identical E0_OUTPUT_SEAL.json.

execution_architecture.canonical_json: UTF-8, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=false, terminal newline
execution_architecture.input_boundary: A local immutable machine-evidence packet; acquisition is outside the sealed core and must later be separately provenance-bound.

semantic_exit_contract.0: valid complete machine-first artifact set emitted; prediction may be regression, stable-in-declared-scope, or assurance-incomplete
semantic_exit_contract.20: infrastructure/input-contract failure; no scientific compatibility inference

freeze_rule.amendment_after_freeze: Numbered amendment required. Must state timing relative to Unit003 inspection, machine-first output seal, human gold freeze, and result; scoring-affecting changes invalidate use as the same Ei.
freeze_rule.final_engine_freeze_point: Guarded merge of an exact PR head that passes every qualification gate, followed by successful main replay of the same gates.

machine_input_contract.evidence_file_rule: Every evidence file is addressed by repository-relative packet path and declared SHA-256; the runner recomputes and rejects mismatch, traversal, duplicates, or unlisted bytes.
machine_input_contract.semantic_injection_rule: Input evidence may contain source/document bytes and machine observations, but may not directly assert ESTABLISHED consequence semantics or canonical verdicts.

prediction_policy.incomplete: Mandatory for unresolved material semantics, incomplete refinement, empty interpretation, unsupported evidence, or unavailable required observation.
prediction_policy.regression: May be emitted only from an independently recheckable concrete collapse/relational witness.
prediction_policy.stable: May be emitted only when every frozen material obligation is established, refinement is complete, and material interpretation is nonempty.

purpose: Freeze the target-agnostic machine-first execution and artifact contract before any held-out Unit003 target-specific semantic inspection.

required_gates: semantic seal changes under semantic input change
nonsemantic observation excluded from semantic seal
engine/freeze byte identity uses committed Git objects
existing Corpus enrollment validation remains PASS

semantic_artifact_contract.missing_or_unknown_material_semantics: Represent explicitly as UNRESOLVED and E0_PREDICTED_ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE; never infer compatibility from silence.

witness_policy.invalid_or_unrecheckable_witness: Cannot support regression; prediction falls back to assurance-incomplete unless another valid witness exists.
objective_order: least supporting context/evidence required for failure predicate
